content: Customer Aarav Sharma acknowledged a renewal email from insurance agent Anita Sharma and confirmed review of the attached form. Aarav inquired about the effective date if the form is returned by the 18th, and Anita confirmed the new policy would be effective on the 20th, followed by a confirmation email. Aarav subsequently requested confirmation that his old policy has expired to ensure no coverage gap.

action_items: Aarav to return the renewal form by the 18th
Anita to confirm the expiration status of the old policy
